note: Tempera's commands: one action per operation of the image step on the image doc (the images section), each taking its arguments as args; the library puts the image's snapshot in state.doc; the commands people choose from the menus and keys; and the watches that preview and apply filters, so a panel added by a revision works by setting state.filter.

computed.standardLayout: {{ {panels: {colour: 'colour', properties: 'properties', layers: 'layers'}, collapsed: {colour: false, properties: false, layers: false}, groupHeights: {colour: 158, properties: 236}, popout: {history: false, navigator: false}, groupOrder: ['colour', 'properties', 'layers']} }}
computed.searchItems: {{concat(map(filter(commands, it.enabled != false && !empty(it.title ?? '') && it.name != 'unavailable'), {title: (empty(it.category ?? '') ? '' : it.category + ': ') + it.title, run: it.name}), map(filter(flat(state.tools), it.id), {title: it.title, run: 'setTool', with: {args: {tool: it.id}}}), map(state.doc.layers, {title: 'Layer: ' + it.name, run: 'selectLayer', with: {args: {id: it.id}}}))}}
computed.fillContents: {{[{id: 'foreground', title: 'Foreground Colour', color: state.doc.foreground}, {id: 'background', title: 'Background Colour', color: state.doc.background}, {id: 'black', title: 'Black', color: '#000000'}, {id: 'grey', title: '50% Grey', color: '#808080'}, {id: 'white', title: 'White', color: '#ffffff'}]}}

perform.note: Runs an action with arguments, for the scenarios: event.run and event.args.

discardDocument.note: Tempera always shows a document: closing one leaves a blank one in its place.

drawSample.note: The sample, 1200 × 800: a dawn sky, a sun and hills, each a layer; then no history, and the brush.

trimImage.title: Trim
trimImage.description: Crops the image to the box around its visible pixels that aren't transparent.

do.to: {{state.doc.width * args.height > state.doc.height * args.width ? [max(1, floor(state.doc.height * args.width / args.height)), state.doc.height] : [state.doc.width, max(1, floor(state.doc.width * args.height / args.width))]}}

applyTransform.note: The transform dialog's values move, scale and turn the active layer, or the selection's outline.

transformBox.note: The Properties panel's W, H, X and Y: the active layer moves and scales as the box (the selection, or the image) would.

distributeLayers.title: Distribute
distributeLayers.description: Spaces the layers picked together evenly, by an edge or their middles.

rasterizeLayer.title: Rasterize Layer
rasterizeLayer.description: Makes the active type or shape layer a pixel layer, to paint on it.

newTypeLayer.title: New Type Layer
newTypeLayer.description: Adds a type layer in the foreground colour, to edit in the Properties panel.

newWorkPath.title: New Path
newWorkPath.description: Adds an empty path and chooses the Pen to draw it.

strokeActivePath.title: Stroke Path
strokeActivePath.description: Strokes the active path on the active layer with the foreground colour, the brush's size wide.

fillActivePath.title: Fill Path
fillActivePath.description: Fills the active path on the active layer with the foreground colour.

selectActivePath.title: Make Selection
selectActivePath.description: Selects the inside of the active path.

shapeFromPath.title: Make Shape Layer
shapeFromPath.description: Makes a shape layer of the active path, in the foreground colour.

showFilter.note: Only sets state, so a revision's button may run it; the watches preview.

toggleLayerKind.to: {{ {on: true, kinds: contains(state.layerFilter.kinds, args.kind) ? filter(state.layerFilter.kinds, it != args.kind) : concat(state.layerFilter.kinds, [args.kind])} }}

pickLayer.to: {{(event.shift || event.mod) ? (contains(computed.pickedBase, args.id) ? filter(computed.pickedBase, it != args.id) : concat(computed.pickedBase, [args.id])) : []}}

moveGroup.note: A group's tabs dropped onto another group's: the group dragged takes that group's place.

then.to: {{concat(slice(filter(state.groupOrder, it != args.from), 0, indexOf(state.groupOrder, args.onto)), [args.from], slice(filter(state.groupOrder, it != args.from), indexOf(state.groupOrder, args.onto)))}}

guidePressed.note: A ruler or a guide pressed: nothing dragged yet, and where the guide pressed is.

guideOut.note: A ruler dragged: past its edge, over the image, a guide follows the pointer (level out of the top ruler, upright out of the side one); back on the ruler, there is none.

to.at: {{args.axis == 'horizontal' ? state.doc.view.y + (event.top - event.height - computed.canvasHeight / 2) / computed.px : state.doc.view.x + (event.left - event.width - computed.canvasWidth / 2) / computed.px}}

guideLetGo.note: A guide let go off the image, onto its ruler, goes.

guideLetGo.if: {{(args.axis == 'vertical' ? computed.canvasWidth / 2 + (state.guides.vertical[args.index] - state.doc.view.x) * computed.px : computed.canvasHeight / 2 + (state.guides.horizontal[args.index] - state.doc.view.y) * computed.px) < 0}}

useLayout.note: Puts the dock as a workspace keeps it.

chooseWorkspace.note: Chooses a workspace: standard, painting (the colours tall, the properties folded), or one saved.

args.layout: {{args.name == 'standard' ? computed.standardLayout : args.name == 'painting' ? {panels: {colour: 'swatches', properties: 'properties', layers: 'layers'}, collapsed: {colour: false, properties: true, layers: false}, groupHeights: {colour: 260, properties: 236}, popout: computed.standardLayout.popout} : find(state.workspaces, it.name == args.name).layout}}

do.value: {{ {name: 'Workspace ' + (length(state.workspaces) + 1), layout: {panels: state.panels, collapsed: state.collapsed, groupHeights: state.groupHeights, popout: state.popout, groupOrder: state.groupOrder}} }}

lastFilter.title: Last Filter
lastFilter.description: Applies the filter last applied again, with its values.

takeSnapshot.title: New Snapshot
takeSnapshot.description: Keeps the layers as they are, as a snapshot in the History panel, to restore later.

measureTones.note: Levels and Curves show the image's tones; other layers don't need them measured.

full.title: Full Screen Mode with Menu Bar
